item.title: Celebrating Judy Schehr Wild: A Life Of Family And Adventure In Plymouth
item.description: Judith Wild, a beloved mother and grandmother, dedicated her life to family and a rewarding career at General Mills, while passionately embracing travel and sports with her partner and loved ones.

item.description: Jayne Wruck, a beloved St. Cloud resident known for her faith and community spirit, passed away peacefully at Quiet Oaks Hospice, leaving behind a legacy of love and family memories.

item.description: Dianna Lund of Zimmerman, Minnesota, passed away at 81, remembered for her love of card games and family gatherings, with a memorial service planned to celebrate her life.

item.description: A morning crash in Eden Lake Township pinned a driver inside his van after colliding with a parked box truck, but thankfully he only suffered minor injuries.
